evan_sales: Heads-up — enterprise prospect (regulated fintech) asked if we can run a 6-week on‑prem POC in an isolated colo (no egress). Key asks: delta-only minibundles over USB, HSM key import for customer KMS, and explicit SLA for patch cadence. Need pricing + short runbook they can give security.

marie_sre: We can do offline minibundles and signed hotfixes. Two engineering constraints: 1) minibundles must be chunked + signed to allow resumable USB transfer, 2) KV cache warmup for LLMs needs initial prefix snapshot to avoid huge cold-start costs.

ev an_sales: @marie_sre typo in your handle but got it :grin: — can you sketch ops steps we give the customer? They'll need exact commands for verification.

nguyen_se: Ops sketch (short):
1) Deliver signed minibundle tar blobs and manifest (sha256).
2) Customer imports root signing key into HSM or passes PKCS#11 token to installer.
3) Run offline verifier and apply delta: `redwood-offline verify --manifest manifest.json` then `redwood-offline apply --bundle bundle-0003.tar`.
Example verify output:
```
$ redwood-offline verify --manifest manifest.json
manifest: ok
bundle-0003.tar: signature ok (key-id: GOV-KMS-2026)
checksums: ok
```
(we'll include exact binary names in POC bundle).

tara_ps: For pricing, suggest a POC fee model: one-time POC support fee ($8k) covering engineering time + packaging + on-call for the 6 weeks, plus a signed-bundle delivery fee ($1k per minibundle) OR a flat delta-license ($3k) if they expect >5 minibundles. Also propose optional extended SLAs for offline: 24/7 phone for $4k/mo.

ev an_sales: Customer pushed back on per-bundle fee; they want a capped charge. Can you give a scoped quote: POC fee + capped bundle budget (eg, up to 6 minibundles included) + per-hotfix after?

ashley_security: From questionnaire POV: we can fill the security spreadsheet with these entries:
- Image signing: supported, we provide SBOM and signed manifests.
- Telemetry: off by default in private deployments; any telemetry requires explicit opt-in via airgap-enabled config.
- Key management: we support PKCS#11 + wrapped import for customer HSM. Note: we do not ship private keys; the customer imports their key material or we accept a wrapped/import blob to the HSM.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2 report + IMA attestation available on request.
I'll attach the minimal wording they can paste into the questionnaire.

marie_sre: Upgrade cadence recommendation for POC: monthly minibundle for noncritical improvements, and a signed emergency hotfix path (one-off) for security patches. For production we recommend quarterly minibundle cadence + scheduled maintenance windows. If they want weekly rapid changes, we need to switch to a dedicated private deployment and enable limited egress for faster rollouts.

evan_sales: Great. Action items: @tara_ps put together the capped quote (POC $ + up to 6 minibundles + per-hotfix overage), @marie_sre and @nguyen_se produce the 2‑page runbook and the `redwood-offline` example commands, @ashley_security produce the questionnaire snippets. I'll sync with the customer tomorrow EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created -> #SW-19234 (POC-offline-bundle) assigned to nguyen_se, due 2026-05-10.

ev an_sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:
